manifest.name: literal-front
manifest.codec: global varint skip/length with raw literal characters
manifest.abi: Repeat skip LEB128, literalLength LEB128, literal bytes until screen position 1000. Values 0..1000 use at most two bytes.
manifest.memoryAccounting: Meaningful loaded bytes excludes PRG address-gap padding, working screen RAM, color RAM, and zero page. Code state excludes the separately counted pointer table and playback bytecode. The first screen is cleared at startup and has no stored seed.

scope: Complete embedded PLAY/HOLD program, including every requested repetition and final HOLD for finite scripts. No music or interrupt workload.
safe_scanout_scope: All 298 displayed images were compared in both PAL fields using actual VIC screenshots. Playback counters and all real wrap transitions were checked.

heldFieldProof.method: Unmodified native checkpoints. Every requested finite repetition and held field, including all closing deltas, uses actual VIC screenshots with forced refresh disabled. Infinite scripts use a bounded repetition sample.
